title: Public Property API (Backend)
goal: Create public API routes for property listings, detail, stats, and lead capture — no auth required.
result_summary: Created /public routes: GET /public/properties (paginated, filterable by location/type/category/intent/price range, sortable), GET /public/properties/:id (with owner name), GET /public/stats (total properties/locations/clients), POST /public/contact (lead capture: upserts Contact with source='website', creates Interaction with channel='website'). Registered as public route in app.ts (no auth).
